acceptance: Exact immutable source token/text/position prefixes in every run; independent full-head controls separate.
Same logical upload/source bytes, pool geometry and cache/host/device caps.
At least75% reduction of median target minor faults; at least5% gain in paired geometric mean cold-cohort throughput, with warm-cohort geometric mean latency no worse than1.05x.

Keep every run and reject/revise an unhelpful candidate; do not retune workload after seeing results.

interpretation: On this checkpoint/profile/GPU and fixed large-RAM prefill workload, the unchanged strict repeat passes all prospective gates: paired geometric mean cold throughput1.789x, total burst throughput1.567x, warm latency0.996x, median minor-fault ratio0.01033. This is an expert-RAM paging result, not a GPU-kernel, decode, vLLM parity or universal performance claim.

limitations: Single checkpoint/profile/GPU and three accepted pairs; CPU frequency/affinity are not locked and broad hardware benefit is not established.
Performance workload is two identical1026-token prefill cohorts with1output each, under195060MiB RAM cache; no decode or sustained offered-load SLO claim.
The OS filesystem cache is warm for accepted timed runs; application expert caches start empty for each process and retain data for the second cohort.

Managed payload reservations include the full slab and retained idle resources. Process RSS and sampled device memory are different metrics; allocator/driver/OS-cache overhead is not an exact physical cap.
Precise exposed transfer stalls, varied cold/warm expert working sets, broader four-family performance and native folded/small/decode joint execution remain open.
Modern full-model AVX2/AVX512/NEON and Metal qualification remain open; generic platform fallback tests are not backend qualification.
